identificationModule.briefTitle: A Global Study to Assess the Effects of MEDI4736 (Durvalumab), Given as Monotherapy or in Combination With Tremelimumab Determined by PD-L1 Expression Versus Standard of Care in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Open Label, Randomised, Multi-centre, International Study of MEDI4736, Given as Monotherapy or in Combination With Tremelimumab Determined by PD-L1 Expression Versus Standard of Care in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (Stage IIIB-IV) Who Have Received at Least Two Prior Systemic Treatment Regimens Including One Platinum Based Chemotherapy Regimen and Do Not Have Known EGFR TK Activating Mutations or ALK Rearrangements (ARCTIC).

armGroups.label: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) monotherapy in Sub-study A
armGroups.description: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) by intravenous infusion. Sub-study A for patients with PD-L1 positive tumors.

armGroups.label: Standard of Care in Sub-study A
armGroups.description: Investigator choice from Vinorelbine, Gemcitabine and Erlotinib. Sub-study A for patients with PD-L1 positive tumors.

armGroups.label: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) + tremelimumab in Sub-study B
armGroups.description: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) by intravenous infusion and tremelimumab by intravenous infusion. Sub-study B for patients with PD-L1 negative tumors.
interventionNames: Drug: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) in combination with tremelimumab (anti-CTLA4)

armGroups.label: Standard of Care in Sub-study B
armGroups.description: Investigator choice from Vinorelbine, Gemcitabine and Erlotinib. Sub-study B for patients with PD-L1 negative tumors.

armGroups.label: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) monotherapy in Sub-study B
armGroups.description: MEDI4736 (durvalumab) by intravenous infusion. Sub-study B for patients with PD-L1 negative tumors.

armGroups.label: tremelimumab in Sub-study B
armGroups.description: tremelimumab by intravenous infusion. Sub-study B for patients with PD-L1 negative tumors.

interventions.name: Vinorelbine
interventions.description: Vinorelbine by intravenous infusion. Administered at a dose of 30 mg/m2 iv on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of a 28-day cycle.
armGroupLabels: Standard of Care in Sub-study A
Standard of Care in Sub-study B

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Gemcitabine by intravenous infusion. Administered at a dose of 1000 mg/m2 iv over 30 minutes on Days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle.
armGroupLabels: Standard of Care in Sub-study A
Standard of Care in Sub-study B

interventions.name: Erlotinib
interventions.description: Erlotinib administered at a dose of 150 mg once daily as a tablet for oral administration
armGroupLabels: Standard of Care in Sub-study A
Standard of Care in Sub-study B
